vantry_chirp_2a.title: WORK ORDER 001 — THE CHIRP
vantry_chirp_2a.summary: A Vantry point in 2A is issuing a line-test tone at three in the morning. The Handbook says battery. The interior has no battery bay: the carbon transmitter capsule has failed and its contacts are fouled.

reported.text: Mina Vale reports a recurring line-test chirp, annotated to the minute.

stage_objectives.issued: A Vantry point in 2A is issuing a line-test tone. Find it by ear.
stage_objectives.acknowledged: Follow the chirp to the 2A point and open the grille.
stage_objectives.diagnosed: No battery bay. The carbon transmitter capsule has failed and its contacts are fouled.
stage_objectives.awaiting_part: Obtain a replacement carbon transmitter capsule from the hardware counter.
stage_objectives.repairable: Replace the capsule at the 2A Vantry point: open the grille, seat the capsule, secure the contacts, close and test.
stage_objectives.repaired: The line is quiet. Tell Mina the chirp is done.

lena_radiator_round_2b.title: WORK ORDER 002 — BORROWED BREATH
lena_radiator_round_2b.summary: Lena Ortiz reports that the 2B radiator exhales while the iron stays cold. Compare the vent's flow with the lobby annunciator's contact and the boiler column's pressure before changing the fitting.

reported.text: Lena Ortiz asks for the radiator to be read as part of the whole building before anybody replaces what looks wrong.

stage_objectives.issued: Go to 2B and hear Lena describe what the radiator does before touching it.
stage_objectives.acknowledged: Inspect the 2B radiator vent, then compare its flow with the lobby call contacts and the basement water column.
stage_objectives.diagnosed: The boiler has pressure and the call contacts carry it: 2B's air vent is the local restriction.
stage_objectives.awaiting_part: No purchased part is required for this service round.
stage_objectives.repairable: Return to 2B. Free and clock the vent, then leave the one-pipe supply fully open.
stage_objectives.repaired: The radiator breathes before it warms. Return to Lena and tell her what the visible repair proves.
stage_objectives.closed: WORK ORDER CLOSED — THE PATCH IS VISIBLE AND HOLDING.
